name: pyside-shell
implemented: Added a desktop Python package under desktop/zzallog with pure state models for update checks, login sessions, and worker approval status.
Added DesktopConfig validation that rejects Supabase service role keys in the PC program configuration.
Added a DesktopAuthFlow that blocks login when forced updates are required and blocks dashboard entry for non-approved workers.
Added a PySide6-capable entrypoint that renders a minimal login/update screen when PySide6 is installed and falls back to a CLI readiness check when it is not.
Added desktop unittest coverage and wired npm test to run both Vitest and desktop Python tests.
